subject: resid() method for sem() not working after 0.5-16 upgrade?

messages.author: 3eaf9abccea468e2
messages.subject: resid() method for sem() not working after 0.5-16 upgrade?
parts:
I just updated to 0.5-16 version of lavaan. However, my code that worked perfectly well before produces now an error when I try to extract residuals from a sem model.

E.g.:

sem.model <- sem()

resid(sem.model, "obs")

Error in: VETA[[g]] %*% t(LAMBDA[[g]]) : non-conformable arguments

Does anyone have any idea what's going on?

Cheers,

Antti

messages.author: 3eaf9abccea468e2
messages.subject: resid() method for sem() not working after 0.5-16 upgrade?
parts: Just an extra note: resid without "obs" works as it should.

messages.author: 3eaf9abccea468e2
messages.subject: Re: resid() method for sem() not working after 0.5-16 upgrade?
parts:
Here is the  code:

# Retrieving needed packages

require(lavaan)

# Retrieving the data

load("example_data.Rdata")

# Structural equations model

sem.model <- 'y.1 ~ c(b1a,b1b,b1c,b1d,b1e,b1f)*x.1 + y2005 + y2006 + y2007 + y2009
              y.2 ~ c(b21a,b21b,b21c,b21d,b21e,b21f)*x.21 +
                    c(b22a,b22b,b22c,b22d,b22e,b22f)*x.22 + y2005 + y2006 + y2007 + y2009
              y.3 ~ c(b31a,b31b,b31c,b31d,b31e,b31f)*x.21 +
                    c(b32a,b32b,b32c,b32d,b32e,b32f)*x.32 + y2005 + y2006 + y2007 + y2009

              b21a == b31a
              b21b == b31b
              b21c == b31c
              b21d == b31d
              b21e == b31e
              b21f == b31f

              b21a == -b22a/(1-b1a)
              b21b == -b22b/(1-b1b)
              b21c == -b22c/(1-b1c)
              b21d == -b22d/(1-b1d)
              b21e == -b22e/(1-b1e)
              b21f == -b22f/(1-b1f)

              b22a == b32a
              b22b == b32b
              b22c == b32c
              b22d == b32d
              b22e == b32e
              b22f == b32f'

# First CES
CES.1 <- sem(sem.model, data=data.1, group = "ts2", start = "Mplus")


# Extraction of the results
 
CES.est.1 <- parameterEstimates(CES.1)

sigma.upper.1 <- subset(CES.est.1, lhs == "y.1" & rhs == "x.1")
sigma.lower.1 <- subset(CES.est.1, lhs == "y.2" & rhs == "x.22")
sigma.lower.1$est <- 1 - sigma.lower.1$est

alfa1.1 <- subset(CES.est.1, lhs == "y.1" & op == "~1")
alfa2.1 <- subset(CES.est.1, lhs == "y.2" & op == "~1")
alfa3.1 <- subset(CES.est.1, lhs == "y.3" & op == "~1")

resid.1 <- NULL
for(i in 1:6){
    resid.1[[i]] <- as.data.frame(resid(CES.1, "obs")[i])
}

sysresid.1 <- NULL
for(i in 1:3){
    sysresid.1[[i]] <- c(resid.1[[1]][,i],resid.1[[2]][,i],resid.1[[3]][,i],
                         resid.1[[4]][,i],resid.1[[5]][,i],resid.1[[6]][,i])
}

I will send you some of the data privately so that you can check it.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: resid() method for sem() not working after 0.5-16 upgrade?
parts:
Confirmed. This is the same bug affecting predict() (see
http://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot5.html) and only happens if you have
exogenous covariates in the model (as in your case).

Will be fixed ASAP.

Yves.
